nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground (512x512)
nodes.description: 512x512 RGBA foreground layer for Android adaptive icon. Contains app logo/graphic in blue (~rgb(36,140,238)) on transparent background. 90.5% transparent, with blue content in the safe zone. Pairs with android-icon-background.png.
